How concept D goes together

Step through the build. Every part prints flat with no supports; only 2 screws are reachable from outside, under the magnet plate.

Step

Print plan (all fit a 180 mm bed)

  • Key body 125 mm, back down, textured plate.
  • Head body 79 mm, back down, textured plate.
  • Key + head face panels, face down, smooth plate (slight gloss).
  • Collar on its side: the roller slot is a 12 mm bridge.
  • Caps, rockers, D-pad ring flange down. Wheel on its side. Magnet plate outer face down.

Fasteners

  • 2 screws: collar tongue to key floor (from the face side).
  • 4 screws: display board, two of them through the collar fork.
  • 2 screws: key panel, from the back, under the magnet plate.
  • Snaps and hooks: key panel and head panel at the collar lips; head panel at the tip.
